title: S8 governed shared-parameter consistency to IDS 1.0 mapping

mapping_contract.source_semantics: Governed shared parameters are centrally defined by stable TIVERIT/Revit identity and required structural properties.
mapping_contract.projectable_semantics: Where a governed IFC entity/property-set/property-name mapping exists, applicable property presence and value/data expectations may be projected into IDS requirements.
mapping_contract.retained_tiverit_semantics: Central registry identity, Revit shared-parameter GUID authority, change governance, and source-registry version context remain governed by TIVERIT and are not transferred to IDS.
mapping_contract.generation_precondition: Do not generate an IDS property requirement until the applicable TIVERIT shared parameter has an explicitly governed IFC property-set and property-name mapping.

limitations: IDS does not directly represent Revit shared-parameter GUID authority as the canonical TIVERIT identity key.
The current repository does not yet contain a governed IFC property-set/property-name mapping for the shared-parameter registry entries.
A valid IDS projection can check IFC-facing information requirements but cannot replace the TIVERIT central registry or its change-control authority.
Geometry and Revit application-state checks remain outside this IDS mapping.

provenance.migration_note: First interoperability-plane pilot. The mapping is intentionally partial and blocks .ids generation until a governed IFC property mapping exists, preventing silent loss of Revit GUID and registry authority semantics.
